title: Sunday · the motel at 3 AM
logline: Three months into nights: the Driftwood Motel from 101 at 3 AM in December rain, VACANCY lit, the office lit, the ice machine's hum drawn as a line under all three tiers.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the motel from across 101 at 3 AM in rain: the two-story walkway, three room lights, VACANCY, the office glowing. The hum line beneath.

image.prompt: a two-story roadside motel across a highway at 3 AM in rain with a lit VACANCY sign and a glowing office and three room lights, a flat line beneath the tier, no words

panels.composition: Tier 2: through the office glass: the desk, a figure bent over it, drawing. The hum line.

image.prompt: a motel office seen through its glass door at night with a figure bent over the desk drawing, a flat line beneath the tier, no words

panels.name: Desk

panels.composition: Tier 3: the sign, DRIFTWOOD, half its tubes lit, rain through the light. The hum line. Held.

image.prompt: a motel's neon sign with half its tubes lit in rain, a flat line beneath the tier, no words

panels.name: Sign

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The motel from 101. The hum under three tiers.
